title: Virtual Assistant — Executive Support
description: Provide executive-level support including calendar management, email correspondence, travel booking, and report preparation. Strong written English required. Amharic a plus.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Bilingual EN/AM)
description: Handle customer inquiries via chat, email, and phone in both English and Amharic. Resolve issues using the company knowledge base. Training provided.

title: Data Entry & Research Virtual Assistant
description: Conduct online research, compile data into spreadsheets, verify records, and produce summary reports. 20 hrs/week. Entry-level welcome.

title: Social Media Manager (Part-time, Remote)
description: Create and schedule content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook. Monitor engagement metrics, write captions, and produce monthly analytics reports.

title: AI-Assisted Content Writer
description: Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Grammarly) to draft and edit blog posts, product descriptions, and educational content. Must be able to review AI output critically.

title: Project Coordinator — EdTech Startup
description: Coordinate cross-functional teams, track project milestones in Asana, prepare status reports, and facilitate weekly standups. 1-year experience preferred.

title: Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant
description: Record financial transactions, reconcile accounts, generate invoices, and prepare basic P&L statements using QuickBooks. Accounting background preferred.

title: E-commerce Operations Assistant
description: List products, manage inventory data, handle order fulfilment inquiries, write product descriptions, and liaise with suppliers.

title: Transcription & Translation Specialist (EN ↔ AM)
description: Transcribe audio recordings and translate documents between English and Amharic. Medical and legal glossaries provided. Per-word rate.

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator (Remote)
description: Post job ads, screen CVs, schedule interviews, maintain applicant tracking system, and draft offer letters. HRIS experience a plus.
